statement: An international body gains inspection or compute-verification powers covering >= 2 of the top-5 compute jurisdictions (treaty text, official gazettes; by 2029-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met. International AI activity in the window was limited to a bilateral trade-and-technology council issuing a non-binding roadmap on evaluation and measurement tools; the only multilateral AI instrument in force was a non-binding ethics recommendation. No body had inspection or compute-verification powers. No qualifying event found in the window (search result, not counted).

items.summary: Bloc A and a non-top-3 regional bloc, at their trade-and-technology council, issued a first joint roadmap on evaluation and measurement tools for trustworthy AI and risk management, plus research cooperation. Non-binding coordination; no inspection or verification body.
items.detail: Bloc A-Bloc C Joint Statement of the Trade and Technology Council, 2022-12-05 (verified via web_extract this run): 'Joint Roadmap on Evaluation and Measurement Tools for Trustworthy AI and Risk Management (AI Roadmap)'; pilot on privacy-enhancing technologies.

items.summary: The only global AI standard applicable to all UN-agency member states at the time was a non-binding ethics recommendation (adopted 2021) built on principles and policy action areas, with human oversight emphasised; it confers no inspection or verification powers.
items.detail: UNESCO, 'Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence', adopted November 2021, applicable to 194 member states (verified via web_extract this run; the landing page itself is dated 2023-05-16 / updated 2024, so only the 2021 adoption fact is used; exact adoption day not shown on the page).

items.summary: No proposal for an international AI inspection or compute-verification body by governments of top-5 compute jurisdictions was located in the window; the chip-control action in the window was unilateral export licensing.
items.detail: Searched this run. The multilateral dual-use export regime's 2022 plenary (Vienna, 2022-11-30..12-01) updated high-performance-computer controls per a search snippet, but its statement could not be opened (404/422) and is not used as an item. Reference opened: TTC joint statement above.
